criteria.evidence: Opening the user card writes admin.read.personal (events #67, journal §14.4, §28.7). server/tests/admin-users.test.ts and server/tests/admin-pd-audit.test.ts: the card writes exactly one row carrying actor, subject, context 'admin.users' and purpose 'admin.user.read', and it reveals the full address; the masked list writes no row at all (users.md §8); a search writes one row keyed by the hashed query with purpose 'admin.users.search', while a query shorter than three characters is not a filter and adds nothing; a service record and an unknown id answer the same (null) and write nothing; editor and moderator get FORBIDDEN with action 'admin.users.read'. The browser scenario web/tests/e2e/73-admin-users.spec.ts checks the same rows in the database for both the card and the search.

Blocking archives the articles with a staff actor and the author cannot restore them (journal §3.3, §4.2–4, §5.4, #4, #30). server/tests/admin-users.test.ts: the cascade sets archivedByActorId to the staff id, archivedByRole to the staff role and archiveReason 'account_archive' on the active articles only, leaves an article the author archived earlier with its own actor, revokes every session and writes user.archive with mode, reasonCategory, cascadeArticles, sessionsRevoked and the running planUntil (journal #50); the real articleResolver.Mutation.restoreArticle then answers the author FORBIDDEN with no update and no audit row. server/tests/admin-users-database.test.ts repeats it on a real PostgreSQL, where the account archive, the session revocation and the article cascade are one transaction; web/tests/e2e/73-admin-users.spec.ts repeats it in the browser and additionally sees HTTP 410 on the public author page right after the block.

Every state row of users.md §9 is reproducible. web/tests/e2e/73-admin-users.spec.ts covers «Пусто» (a filter with no match), «Ошибка» (a rejected query shows ErrorState with the retry button), «Нет прав на часть действий» (analyst opens the card with no buttons, no sessions and no internal reason) and «Конфликт» twice — archiving an already archived account and restoring an active one. The same file shows the results of the actions: the block closes access, revokes sessions, archives the articles with the staff actor and answers 410 on the author page; the restore returns access and leaves the articles archived; the emergency mode records its own mode; session revocation keeps the account active; the staff address change leaves no address in the audit diff. «Загрузка» lasts a fraction of a second and is checked without the network in web/tests/admin-users-page.nuxt.test.ts, together with the requestId line — the error dictionary only exposes requestId for INTERNAL_ERROR and PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE. «Лимит» is marked 'не применимо' in the specification: administrative actions are not rate limited.
